name: Knight of Swords
body:
Duplicitous and violent, you are a rogue element upon both battlefield and court, leaving chaos and confusion in your wake.

Prerequisite(s): Challenge class feature; Evil alignment; Str

Benefit: You may expend a use of your Challenge ability to give yourself a bonus to Bluff and Intimidate equal to half your cavalier level (rounding up). This bonus lasts for 1 minute, plus 1 additional minute at 5th level and for every 5 levels thereafter.

Special: You may only possess 1 Knightly feat.
